title: A&F Co. Announces Q4 and Full Year 2025 Earnings Results
summary: Today, we were thrilled to share our Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results, and as a company, we delivered on our goals. We achieved another year of record sales, growth across regions and channels, and double-digit operating margins, with Hollister delivering its best year ever and A&F returning to growth in the fourth quarter.
body_markdown:
Today, we were thrilled to share our Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results, and as a company, we delivered on our goals.


We achieved another year of record sales, growth across regions and channels, and double-digit operating margins, with Hollister delivering its best year ever and A&F returning to growth in the fourth quarter.


[Read more about our Q4 and full year 2025 earnings results](https://wwd.com/business-news/retail/abercrombie-amp-fitch-sustains-sales-momentum-in-q4-1238646630/)
